method_notes: Predictions favor teams with superior tournament goal differences and clean sheets, while factoring in fatigue for teams like Paraguay and Egypt who endured penalty shootouts in the Round of 32.

predictions.reasoning: France's lethal attack and dominant 3-0 form should comfortably bypass a fatigued Paraguay side coming off an intense penalty shootout.
Canada's strong defensive stability shown in their two consecutive clean sheets will narrowly stifle Morocco's attack.
Brazil's balanced depth and elite pedigree will expose Norway's vulnerable backline, which has conceded 8 goals so far.
Mexico's formidable defensive shape on home continent soil will drag England to extra time, where El Tri edges it.
Spain's impressive tournament record of zero goals conceded will face a stern test but ultimate victory against Iberian rivals Portugal.
The United States utilizes home advantage and great defensive organization to narrowly outlast a high-scoring Belgium squad.
Colombia's exceptionally stingy defense will hold firm against an Egypt side worn down by their recent marathon shootout.
Argentina's relentless attack, having already racked up 11 tournament goals, will prove too potent for Switzerland to contain.
